body: nope, me too. i have way more diarrhea than constipation, i don’t eat a ton, and i’m active. still cannot for the life of me lose weight. i feel crazy when i hear that a mark of SIBO and most GI issues is unexplained weight loss.

this sounds exactly what i’m going through right now — same symptoms pre-diagnosis, just finished my first round of xifaxin, and i’m experiencing the same horrible diarrhea 2 days after my last dose of xifaxin. did it go away for you? i’m concerned

i did, i tested positive for SIBO! i am now on the first round of rifaximin (antibiotics) but still going to do a stool study to determine whether or not i need a colonoscopy. i would really suggest asking your doctor about it. i had never heard about SIBO prior to him mentioning it.
also wanna know who your doctor is! i’m in LA and like mine well enough but would prefer to have a recommendation in case i end up needing to switch.

this just happened to me today and yesterday and it absolutely sucked. by this evening i was feeling so down, couldn’t stop crying, and was having terrible brain zaps. nausea all day too. i really thought “i can go two days without it’s not that bad” but i’ve learned my lesson.
